an3.55:1.1: Atha kho Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.55:1.2: Sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānan ti bho Gotama vuccati.
an3.55:1.3: Kittāvatā bho Gotama sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti akālikaṃ ehipassikaṃ opanayikaṃ paccattaṃ veditabbaṃ viññūhī ti?
an3.55:2.1: Ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāya pi ceteti . . . pe (54) . . . ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:2.2: Rāge pahīne n' eva attavyābādhāya pi ceteti . . . pe (53) . . . na ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:2.3: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.55:3.2: Mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāya pi ceteti . . . pe . . . ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:3.3: Mohe pahīne n' eva attavyābādhāya pi ceteti . . . pe . . . na ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:3.4: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti . . . pe (54) . . .
an3.55:4.1: Yato kho ayaṃ brāhmaṇa anavasesaṃ rāgakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti anavasesaṃ dosakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti anavasesaṃ mohakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:4.2: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti akālikaṃ ehipassikaṃ opanayikaṃ paccattaṃ veditabbaṃ viññūhī ti.
an3.55:5.2: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
